outcome: Long-running tool effects can execute independently of the active model turn while preserving ExHarness effect identity, recovery and authority semantics.
currentProblem: AgentRuntime.invoke currently awaits capability.execute, so a long capability call blocks strategy progress. Core already has durable effect identity and reconciliation, but no detached operation scheduling surface that can return RUNNING and later deliver terminal state.
constraints: Async scheduling is transport/scheduling only; EffectOperation remains the authority for external-effect identity and confirmation.
Detached execution must never permit duplicate non-idempotent effects after restart, cancellation or concurrent wakeup.
Existing synchronous capability behavior remains supported as a baseline/fallback.
Operation handles and terminal updates must be deterministic, durable enough for recovery and attributable to exact call/turn/action intent.
successCriteria: A long-running capability can return a durable RUNNING handle without blocking unrelated strategy work and later publish one terminal result.
Restart/recovery reconciles the exact existing effect operation and cannot silently dispatch a second semantic effect.
Cancellation fences new work and either cancels safely or leaves an explicit reconcilable/unknown operation state.
